segments.an10.36:1.1: “Katihi nu kho, bhante, dhammehi samannāgatena bhikkhunā sāmaṇero upaṭṭhāpetabbo”ti?
segments.an10.36:1.2: “Dasahi kho, upāli, dhammehi samannāgatena bhikkhunā sāmaṇero upaṭṭhāpetabbo.
segments.an10.36:1.4: Idhupāli, bhikkhu sīlavā hoti…pe… samādāya sikkhati sikkhāpadesu;
segments.an10.36:1.6: pātimokkhaṃ kho panassa vitthārena svāgataṃ hoti suvibhattaṃ suppavattaṃ suvinicchitaṃ suttaso anubyañjanaso;
segments.an10.36:1.7: paṭibalo hoti gilānaṃ upaṭṭhātuṃ vā upaṭṭhāpetuṃ vā;
segments.an10.36:1.8: paṭibalo hoti anabhiratiṃ vūpakāsetuṃ vā vūpakāsāpetuṃ vā;
segments.an10.36:1.9: paṭibalo hoti uppannaṃ kukkuccaṃ dhammato vinodetuṃ;
segments.an10.36:1.10: paṭibalo hoti uppannaṃ diṭṭhigataṃ dhammato vivecetuṃ;
segments.an10.36:1.14: Imehi kho, upāli, dasahi dhammehi samannāgatena bhikkhunā sāmaṇero upaṭṭhāpetabbo”ti.
